title: Truss or bridge, side view
description: A generic node-beam structure (a truss, a bridge span, a barrier) seen from the side: two supports, the chords and the load point. A new structure kind is a new JSON file like this one.

orientation.note: x runs from the left support to the right one

elements.label: Right support
elements.hint: Where it rests on its right support.

elements.label: Top chord
elements.hint: Left to right along the top member; one point per panel node.

elements.name: bottom_chord
elements.label: Bottom chord
elements.hint: Left to right along the bottom member.

elements.name: midspan_bottom
elements.label: Midspan, bottom
elements.hint: The bottom chord's node at midspan.
